Complete SRI/sha256 rehashed original/current CDK packages supply genuine public namespace values; complete original/owned modules execute in Chromium with actual public Core decorators, public CDK parent constructors and the complete borrower helper. Borrowed TS6 does not qualify compiler floors. All 288 original/main/21.x final class comparisons agree: owned and mixed-CDK header/data/footer/native/flex cells, sanitized and renamed names, and raw CDK columns. Actual Angular node/module/factory/AOT/packed integration and supported runtime/compiler/RxJS/browser floors remain deferred; only this finite source/public-construction/class-output boundary is admitted, not the whole table or G11.
